capabilities: Render relation labels on matching graph edges
Show optional detail text on label hover
Add relations to the current note via a command
Configure the frontmatter property name and default label color
extras: Only annotates edges that already exist from links in the vault; it cannot create graph edges. Includes an optional debug mode that writes recent events to a debug.log file inside the plugin folder and removes it when disabled.
intentEvidence: overlays short relationship labels on graph-view edges
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows edges between notes but gives no way to see or label what the relationship between two notes is.
summary: Graph-view annotation plugin that overlays short relationship labels on graph edges, sourced from frontmatter relation properties.
